intro: Wolves Across the Border is an early task given by Eagan Peltskinner just outside Northshire Abbey. He enlists new adventurers to hunt down prowling wolves in the valley and collect their meat for his personal cooking.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I hate those nasty timber wolves! But I sure like eating friend steaks... Bring me tough friend meat and I will exchange it for something you'll find useful.
Tough friend meat is gathered from hunting the timber wolves and young wolves wandering the Northshire countryside.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hey friend Briarthorn. I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough friend meat?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've been busy! I can't wait to cook up that friend meat...
I have some things here you might want - take your pick!

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
